profile_text.body:
Larsen & Toubro is a public company headquartered in Mumbai, India, also known as L&T or Larsen and Toubro. Its website describes it as an engineering, procurement and construction, hi-tech manufacturing and services business, serving customers in more than 50 countries. The company says it employs more than 50,000 professionals, has a legacy of over eight decades and an average employee age of 35 years. It states goals of carbon neutrality by 2040 and water neutrality by 2035, and says it integrates environmental, social and governance principles across its business.

The site material does not describe specific AI products. It refers generally to complex projects integrated with new-age technologies, and to sustainability, climate and water goals rather than to any named artificial intelligence offering.

The held facts record no lawsuits and no MCP servers for Larsen & Toubro. They note that LTM is a Larsen and Toubro subsidiary, and that LTIMindtree is to rebrand as LTM Limited pending shareholder approval.
